title: DRE project
description: The project file, `dre_project.yml`, at the project root.

default_profile.description: The connection (in `profiles.yml`) reports use when nothing else names one. May use Jinja with `var()`, `env_var()`, `run.*` and `target.name`.

target.description: The run's target (environment) when neither `--target` nor `DRE_TARGET` sets one. Default: `dev`.

default_output.description: The output every report starts from (the built-in default is `format: csv`). A report's own `output` is merged on top.

format_options.description: Default options per output format, under every output of that format. A report's own keys win.

default_set.description: The Set used when a report has Sets and none is chosen.

vars.description: The lowest level of `var()`: folders, reports, Sets, schedules and `--var` override these.

lookup_inline_max_rows.description: Lookups over this many rows are loaded into a temp table instead of inlined into the SQL.

dispatch.description: Which macro packages `dispatch()` searches, and in what order.

macro_namespace.description: The macro package the dispatching macro belongs to, e.g. `dre_utils`.

search_order.description: Packages searched for the variant, first match wins: this project's name and installed packages.

mask_secrets.description: Whether `DRE_SECRET_*` values are masked as `*****` in the console, logs, JSON events, `run_results.json` and `target/compiled/`.

timezone.description: The timezone `run.date` and `run.now` use, an IANA name such as `Australia/Sydney`. Default: UTC.

week_start.description: The first day of the week for `run.date` week arithmetic.

week_numbering.description: How weeks are numbered: ISO 8601 or US style.

reports.description: Folder config: settings for the report folders, by folder name, nested to match the folders under `reports/`.

target_path.description: Where DRE writes its generated files (compiled SQL, run outputs, the manifest). Default: `target/` in the project. `--target-path` and `DRE_TARGET_PATH` override it.

plugins.description: The plugin packages this project uses. DRE installs them on demand into `dre_deps/` and pins them in `dre.lock`. May be written in any project YAML file; `dependencies.yml` is the usual place.

items.description: One plugin package: just its name, a `name: "<version>"` pair, or a map with `name` and where to get it.

oneOf.description: A package name, e.g. `duckdb`. Any version.
A package name mapped to a version constraint, e.g. `duckdb: ">=1.0"`.

name.description: The package name: lowercase letters, digits and `_`.

version.description: A version constraint such as `1.2.0` or `>=1.0`. Not allowed with `local`.

github.description: Install from the releases of this GitHub repository, `owner/repo`.

local.description: Use the package folder at this path as it is.

registry.description: Install from this registry index (a URL or a path) instead of the default one.

oneOf.description: Package names mapped to version constraints.

plugins.x-doc-type: list of plugin packages: a name, `name: "<version>"`, or a map (see below)

sources.description: dbt-style source declarations (see the sources schema). May be written in any project YAML file.

folder.description: Settings for every report in this folder and the folders below it. Keys starting with `+` are settings; any other key is a subfolder.

+tags.description: Tags added to every report in the folder.

+output.description: Output settings every report in the folder starts from; a report's own keys win.

+profile.description: The connection for reports in the folder. May use Jinja with `var()`, `env_var()`, `run.*` and `target.name`.

+vars.description: Variables, read in SQL and YAML with `var('name')`. Values can be strings, numbers, booleans, lists or maps.

+timezone.description: The timezone `run.date` and `run.now` use, an IANA name such as `Australia/Sydney`. Default: UTC.
